finding.summary: The weekly scenario-only artifact repair passes canonical SID settlement_edges to three consumers whose contract is operational OSID edges. The resulting empty OSID front graph causes final sector reconciliation to erase the materialized standing-OG snapshot. The already-loaded operationalSettlementGraph is the correct input and is already used by the canonical runTurn path and by the final-save geometry pass.
finding.wrong_call: src/scenario/scenario_runner.ts:3243-3248 passes graph.edges loaded at 1559-1563 from data/derived/settlement_edges.json.
consumer_contract: src/map/front_edges.ts:106-118 explicitly accepts OSID adjacency; lines 125-127 resolve each endpoint with getPoliticalControllerOSID and skip null controllers.
src/sim/combat/attack_retreat_displacement.ts:461-485 builds OSID adjacency and evaluates location_osid through the operational-to-canonical reverse map.
src/sim/combat/final_sector_truth_reconciliation.ts:399-423 forwards the same edge domain into the full geometry rebuild.
correct_existing_owners: src/scenario/scenario_runner.ts:2626-2634 loads operationalSettlementGraph before the weekly loop.
src/scenario/scenario_runner.ts:2952-2963 passes operationalSettlementGraph and its edges to canonical runTurn.
src/sim/turn_phases/war_phase_reconciliation_steps.ts:59-111 computes OSID fronts and final sectors from operational data edges.
src/scenario/scenario_runner.ts:3548-3591 already uses loadOperationalEdges for final-save OSID front and sector geometry.

retained_evidence.shadow_result: pass=true; canonical SID graph reproduced exact post-repair target erasure; operational graph preserved both target assignments; canonical sequential and composite paths matched actual post-repair.
target_tuple: hv_113th_brigade_tg at op:capljina:capljina_2, fatigue 0.5, loses sector:hvo_southeast_herzegovina:0 only at reconciliation
hv_4th_guards_tg at op:capljina:capljina_2, fatigue 0.5, loses sector:hvo_southeast_herzegovina:0 only at reconciliation
retained_evidence.claim_limit: The retained offline shadow establishes this domain mismatch and exact local erasure. It does not qualify a repaired campaign or prove historical causality.

authority.rule: Fronts exist on hostile OSID adjacency.
War formation location and OSID-keyed state use OSIDs, stable ordering, deterministic replay and serialization.
War deployment and hostile front boundaries are OSID-based; corps sectors are recomputed at turn boundaries and serialized as the materialized current-turn standing order.
war_front_edges_osid feeds the persisted corps-front-sector snapshot; save load preserves that snapshot rather than rebuilding it.

corps_front_sectors and formation sector assignments are persisted materialized current-turn truth; only listed transient caches are disposable. This accepted ADR already supplies the design decision, so this repair needs no new mechanic or ADR.
Engine invariants and Systems Manual outrank code; deterministic derived state and canonical entrypoint ownership are protected; code contradiction is resolved in code rather than by rewriting canon.

Preserve ordering, serialization, GameState ownership, save compatibility, provenance and acceptance criteria; calibration-affecting behavior requires scenario-first authoritative validation and then the full suite only for a qualifying candidate.

exact_implementation_scope.required_source_change: At src/scenario/scenario_runner.ts:3243-3248, pass operationalSettlementGraph.edges to repairScenarioArtifactState instead of graph.edges.
exact_implementation_scope.allowed_clarity_only: Within repairScenarioArtifactState, rename the local parameter edges to operationalEdges and update its three local uses. This is a runtime-neutral semantic label, not a required behavior change.
exact_implementation_scope.required_test_change: Extend tests/scenario_runner_artifact_repair.test.ts or add one narrowly named scenario-runner regression test that crosses the real one-week scenario loop call site.
max_behavior_files: tests/scenario_runner_artifact_repair.test.ts or one new focused scenario-runner test
explicitly_out_of_scope: No change to buildScenarioStartupState's canonical SID graph or settlementGraph input.

No change to computeFrontEdgesOsid, displaceFormationsInEnemyTerritory, reconcileFinalSectorTruth, sector construction, roster distribution, fatigue, movement, combat, control, enclave rules, bot policy, or final-save ordering.
No copy of scenario artifact repair into desktop/native/public runTurn paths; those already consume operational edges.
No save schema/version/migration change, API field change, data edit, baseline/reference/pin adoption, target-floor change, tuning, threshold change, or forced result.
Do not remove, narrow, reorder, or reinterpret the existing repair sequence in this patch.

first_red_fixture.fixture: Run data/scenarios/apr1992_4w.json for exactly one week through runScenario with diagnosticTurnBoundaryObserver and a fresh test output directory.
first_red_fixture.pre_fix_expected_failure: At completed turn 1, the observer/weekly save has an empty war_front_edges_osid and/or no sector membership for hv_113th_brigade_tg and hv_4th_guards_tg because the real weekly caller supplies SID edges.
post_fix_pass: war_front_edges_osid is nonempty and every endpoint is an op: OSID present in the operational reverse-map domain.
Both retained HVO formations remain members of sector:hvo_southeast_herzegovina:0 at the post-repair turn boundary and in save_w1.
Their location_osid, personnel, cohesion, morale and fatigue values match the ordinary pre-repair turn state; the test must not hand-author pending sectors or call only the helper.
first_red_fixture.meaning: This test exercises the production caller and serialized boundary. The existing helper-only test already proves operational-edge displacement/front behavior but cannot detect the wrong caller argument.

validation_gates.question: Does the production weekly caller preserve real OSID front and sector truth with the correct graph domain?
validation_gates.pass: Focused semantic regression green, TypeScript exit 0, diff check exit 0, and diff confined to approved files plus required closeout records.
validation_gates.stop: Any failure, unexpected mutation, or expanded source surface stops before a campaign.

validation_gates.question: Does the corrected materialized sector state qualify in the authoritative campaign without losing accepted history or provenance?
validation_gates.pass: Use the unchanged active acceptance contract: current checkpoint floors, every formerly-correct n91/n92 cell retained, all 16 protected anchors, clean provenance, exact requested horizon, artifact/state consistency and no unexplained integrity regression. Do not replace this with the prior exact-output V2 check, because the established defect is expected to change outputs.
validation_gates.expected_cost: One authoritative 188-week scenario attempt after cheap gates; no automatic retry.
validation_gates.stop: If the run misses any current floor, formerly-correct cell, anchor, provenance or artifact gate, retain evidence and stop. Do not tune, adopt baselines, lower thresholds, or run the full suite.

validation_gates.question: Does the qualifying candidate preserve the complete repository contract?
validation_gates.pass: Complete discovered suite exits 0 with no unexplained failures and with receipt/inventory checks intact.
validation_gates.expected_cost: One full balanced suite only after Gate 2 qualifies.
validation_gates.stop: Do not repeat unless a later correction invalidates this evidence.

determinism_save_and_ownership.determinism: The fix substitutes an already-loaded immutable operational edge array and introduces no iteration, random source, clock, or ordering rule. Existing OSID consumers sort/canonicalize within their established ownership. Campaign artifacts will intentionally differ from the defective producer, so fresh determinism/provenance evidence is required.
determinism_save_and_ownership.save_compatibility: No field, schema, migration or serializer shape changes. The change restores the existing persisted turn-boundary sector projection mandated by Systems Manual and ADR-0006.
determinism_save_and_ownership.headless_boundary: The scenario runner remains the sole changed owner. Public desktop runTurn already receives operationalSettlementGraph.edges; final-save geometry already reloads operational edges. No native/desktop mutation is authorized.
determinism_save_and_ownership.calibration_status: Source candidate remains unqualified until the fresh authoritative 188-week gate and qualifying full suite complete. Prior n101/source/package/native evidence does not automatically qualify this behavior change.

review_seats.independent_implementation_review: required after implementation; one reviewer may cover code, canon, systems, determinism, save and evidence linkage
review_seats.historian_or_sensitive_history_panel: not required for this exact graph-domain correction because it changes no historical data, enclave rule, operation attribution, authored roster, target or protected control reference. Historical/calibration acceptance remains enforced by the authoritative 188-week anchors and formerly-correct-cell gates.
review_seats.escalation_trigger: Require the applicable historian/canon panel before altering any historical/enclave rule, authored roster, protected reference, attribution, target floor or acceptance criterion in response to a campaign result.

final_claim_limit: GO authorizes only the exact code-domain correction and its tests under the parent's existing implementation authority. It is not a GO for adoption, package/native qualification, historical causality, calibration success, or baseline/reference changes.
